items.title: Preposition + V-ing (Gerund)
items.body:
ভুল: In spite of he is poor
সঠিক: In spite of being poor

items.body:

সঠিক: without taking

items.title: to-preposition + V-ing (বিশেষ 'to')
items.body:
ভুল: with a view to improve
সঠিক: with a view to improving
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: to-preposition + V-ing (বিশেষ 'to')
items.body:
ভুল: used to make (অভ্যস্ত অর্থে)
সঠিক: are used to making
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: কিছু Verb-এর পরে V-ing (Gerund Object)
items.body:
ভুল: cannot help to borrow
সঠিক: cannot help borrowing
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: কিছু Verb-এর পরে V-ing (Gerund Object)
items.body:
ভুল: mind to take
সঠিক: mind taking 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: stop, avoid, mind, keep, finish, dislike, enjoy, means + V-ing • cannot help / would you mind + V-ing • like / love / hate / start / begin + V-ing বা to V1
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: বাক্যের শুরুতে V-ing (Gerund as Subject)
items.body:
ভুল: Teach is a noble profession
সঠিক: Teaching is …
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: Present Participle (V-ing) — একসাথে ঘটা কাজ / বিশেষণ
items.body:
ভুল: Hear this, the king…
সঠিক: Hearing this, … • Participle-এর কর্তা আর main clause-এর কর্তা যেন এক হয়। 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: বাক্যের শুরুতে V-ing …, Subject + Verb • While / When + V-ing • Noun + V-ing (= which/who …) বা সাথে ঘটা কাজ • , + V-ing (ফলাফল / সাথে ঘটা কাজ) • find / see / keep / hear + object + V-ing
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: to + V1 (Infinitive)
items.body:
ভুল: to makes / to made
সঠিক: to make • কিন্তু to-preposition-এ (with a view to) ing! 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Verb + to V1 (want, try, fail, decide, tend, begin, need…) • Adjective + to V1 (able, bound, easy, difficult, important, apt) • উদ্দেশ্য বোঝাতে to V1 / in order to (and দিয়ে যুক্ত infinitive-সহ) • have to / is to / are to / used to + V1 • Noun + to V1 (roles to play, work to earn, anyone to play) • how / what / where + to V1 • It is time + to V1 (subject না থাকলে)
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: Bare Infinitive (to ছাড়া V1)
items.body:
ভুল: makes us to feel
সঠিক: makes us feel 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: make / made + object + V1 • let + object + V1 (let him not come) • help + object + V1 / to V1 • see / hear / watch + object + V1
items.topic: পর্ব ক — V-ing, to + V1 ও V1 — Non-finite রূপ

items.title: Singular Subject → V + s/es (Present Simple)
items.body:
ভুল: Education play
সঠিক: Education plays
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Singular Subject → V + s/es (Present Simple)
items.body:
ভুল: Many a student drop
সঠিক: drops 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: He / She / It + V+s/es • একবচন Countable Noun + V+s/es • Uncountable / Abstract / Proper noun = একবচন • Many a / Each / Every / One of the / Everyone / None • Relative pronoun (which / who / that) — আগের noun একবচন • and / or দিয়ে যুক্ত দ্বিতীয় verb (Parallel)
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Plural Subject / I / You / We / They → V1 (Present Simple)
items.body:
ভুল: Books possesses
সঠিক: Books possess
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Plural Subject / I / You / We / They → V1 (Present Simple)
items.body:
ভুল: the people who appears
সঠিক: appear 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: I / We / You / They + V1 • বহুবচন Noun (books, people, students, schools) + V1 • Relative pronoun (who / that / which) — আগের noun বহুবচন • and / or দিয়ে যুক্ত দ্বিতীয় verb (Parallel)
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: be verb: am / is / are / was / were
items.body:
ভুল: There is many reasons
সঠিক: There are
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: be verb: am / is / are / was / were
items.body:
ভুল: The number of tigers are
সঠিক: is 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Present: am / is / are • Past: was / were • There + be — পরের noun দেখে
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Past Simple (V2) ও used to + V1
items.body:
ভুল: In 1976 he has visited
সঠিক: visited (নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময়ে Perfect নয়)। 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: অতীত নির্দেশক শব্দ আছে (ago, last, in 1971, once, one day, then) • গল্/প ঘটনার বর্ণনা — ধারাবাহিক Past • and / but দিয়ে যুক্ত অতীতের দ্বিতীয় কাজ • used to + V1 — অতীতের অভ্যাস
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Present Perfect (has/have + V3)
items.body:
ভুল: It already proved (বর্তমানে প্রাসঙ্গিক)
সঠিক: has already proved 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: already / just / ever / never / yet / recently থাকলে • since / for (সময়কাল) থাকলে • Clue ছাড়া — বর্তমানে ফলাফল বোঝাতে
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Past Perfect (had + V3) ও Perfect Continuous
items.body:
ভুল: Another thought crossed before he was sent
সঠিক: had crossed 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Past Perfect — অতীতের আগের কাজ (had + V3) • Perfect Continuous (has/have/had been + V-ing)
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Continuous Tense (be + V-ing)
items.body:
ভুল: The number of tigers decreasing
সঠিক: is decreasing 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Present Continuous — now / day by day / currently / at present • Present Continuous — clue ছাড়া, প্রসঙ্গে চলমান • Past Continuous — was/were + V-ing
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Future (will/shall + V1)
items.body:
ভুল: will lagged
সঠিক: will lag (will-এর পরে সবসময় V1)। 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: ভবিষ্যৎ নির্দেশক প্রসঙ্গ (in future, next, by the time) • Otherwise … → will + V1 • believe / think / hope / whether … will
items.topic: পর্ব খ — Tense ও Subject-Verb Agreement

items.title: Modal + V1 (can, should, must, may, would…)
items.body:
ভুল: can maintains / should takes
সঠিক: can maintain / should take 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: can / could / cannot — সামর্থ্য • should / must / have to — উচিত, কর্তব্য, বাধ্যবাধকতা • may / might — সম্ভাবনা • would / will — অতীতের ভবিষ্যৎ, অভ্যাস, ইচ্ছা
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Passive Voice (be + V3)
items.body:
ভুল: English is use
সঠিক: is used
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Passive Voice (be + V3)
items.body:
ভুল: When a child bears
সঠিক: is born 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: be born / be known as / be regarded as / be called / be considered • Present Passive: am / is / are + V3 • Past Passive: was / were + V3 • to be + V3 / be + V3 (Infinitive Passive)
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Modal Passive (Modal + be + V3)
items.body:
ভুল: must be maintain
সঠিক: must be maintained
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Modal Passive (Modal + be + V3)
items.body:
ভুল: can brought
সঠিক: can be brought 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: must / should + be + V3 • can / could + be + V3 • will / may / would + be + V3
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Perfect ও Continuous Passive
items.body:
ভুল: have been neglect
সঠিক: have been neglected 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: has / have / had + been + V3 • is / are / was / were + being + V3
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Past Participle (V3) — বিশেষণ / সংক্ষিপ্ত Passive
items.body:
ভুল: a supreme gift bestow upon us
সঠিক: bestowed
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Past Participle (V3) — বিশেষণ / সংক্ষিপ্ত Passive
items.body:
ভুল: get admit
সঠিক: get admitted 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Noun + V3 (= which is/was + V3) • get / got / remain / become / feel + V3 • Having + V3 / perfect participle • V3 বিশেষণ হিসেবে (an educated mother, lost time)
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Negative: do / does / did + not + V1
items.body:
ভুল: does not knows / did not went
সঠিক: does not know / did not go 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: do not + V1 (I / We / You / They / Plural) • does not + V1 (He / She / It / Singular) • did not + V1 (সব subject — অতীত)
items.topic: পর্ব গ — Modal, Passive ও Negative

items.title: Conditional Sentence (If / Unless / Had …)
items.body:
ভুল: If all children will go
সঠিক: If all children go
items.topic: পর্ব ঘ — Conditional ও Special Structure

items.title: Conditional Sentence (If / Unless / Had …)
items.body:
ভুল: Had I had …, I will visit
সঠিক: would have visited 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: Type 0 — সাধারণ সত্য (If/when + Present → Present) • Type 1 — If + Present → will / can / may + V1 • Type 2 — If + V2/were → would / could + V1 • Type 3 / Had-inversion — had + V3 → would have + V3 • Unless = If … not
items.topic: পর্ব ঘ — Conditional ও Special Structure

items.title: Special Structures: It is (high) time • as if • lest • suggest/recommend that
items.body:
ভুল: It is high time we pay
সঠিক: paid
items.topic: পর্ব ঘ — Conditional ও Special Structure

items.title: Special Structures: It is (high) time • as if • lest • suggest/recommend that
items.body:
ভুল: as if it is
সঠিক: as if it were
items.topic: পর্ব ঘ — Conditional ও Special Structure

items.title: Special Structures: It is (high) time • as if • lest • suggest/recommend that
items.body:
ভুল: lest they will fail
সঠিক: should fail 🗂 এই Rule-এর উপভাগ: It is (high) time + Subject + V2 • as if / as though + were / V2 • lest + Subject + should / might + V1 • recommend / suggest that + Subject + should + V1
items.topic: পর্ব ঘ — Conditional ও Special Structure

items.title: যেসব Verb Continuous হয় না (Stative verbs)
items.body:
ভুল: I am knowing him
সঠিক: I know him.
items.topic: পর্ব ঙ — অতিরিক্ত নিয়ম (উদাহরণসহ)

items.title: যেসব Verb Continuous হয় না (Stative verbs)
items.body:
ভুল: The book is belonging to me
সঠিক: belongs
items.topic: পর্ব ঙ — অতিরিক্ত নিয়ম (উদাহরণসহ)
